title: ChatGPT Ads: What Advertisers Need to Know

facts.fact: According to the page's summary, OpenAI's ChatGPT ad platform reached $100 million in annualized ad revenue within six weeks (a figure attributed to OpenAI, as reported by this third-party blog).
facts.quote: OpenAI's ChatGPT ad platform reached $100 million in annualized ad revenue in six weeks, with fewer than 20% of eligible users seeing ads.

facts.fact: The page reports that fewer than 20% of eligible ChatGPT users were seeing ads at the time of the $100 million revenue figure.
facts.quote: with fewer than 20% of eligible users seeing ads.

facts.fact: The ChatGPT ad platform launched its managed pilot on February 9, 2026.
facts.quote: The ChatGPT ad platform launched its managed pilot on February 9, 2026.

facts.fact: At launch in February 2026, advertisers needed a minimum spend commitment of $250,000 for the managed pilot.
facts.quote: Advertisers needed a minimum spend commitment of $250,000

facts.fact: At launch in February 2026, ChatGPT ad pricing was CPM-only at around $60.
By April 2026, ChatGPT CPMs had dropped to as low as $25, according to the page.
facts.quote: By April 2026, CPMs had dropped to as low as $25

facts.fact: By April 2026, the ChatGPT ad minimum spend requirement had fallen to $50,000.
facts.quote: the minimum spend requirement fell to $50,000.

facts.fact: As of April 2026, the page states there are over 600 advertisers inside the ChatGPT managed pilot.
facts.quote: There are currently over 600 advertisers inside the managed pilot.

facts.fact: Self-serve access to ChatGPT ads was rolling out in April 2026, per the page.
facts.quote: Self-serve access is rolling out in April, which opens the door

facts.fact: Per the page, ChatGPT CPC bids are currently in the $3 to $5 range.
facts.quote: CPC bids on ChatGPT are currently sitting in the $3 to $5 range.

facts.fact: OpenAI reported that fewer than 7% of ads are rated low relevance by users, according to the page.
facts.quote: OpenAI reported fewer than 7% of ads are rated low relevance by users

facts.fact: OpenAI hired Dave Dugan, a former Meta ad executive, to lead ad sales for ChatGPT ads.
facts.quote: OpenAI brought on Dave Dugan, a former Meta ad executive, to lead ad sales.

facts.fact: The page says geographic expansion of ChatGPT ads into Canada, Australia, and New Zealand is being explored.
facts.quote: Geographic expansion into Canada, Australia, and New Zealand is also being explored

facts.fact: At launch, ChatGPT ad geographic availability was focused on the US, per the page's comparison table.
facts.quote: | Geographic Availability | US focus | Expanding to CA, AU, NZ |

facts.fact: At launch, ChatGPT ad access was managed only, with self-serve added later, per the page's comparison table.
facts.quote: | Access Type | Managed only | Managed + Self-serve rolling out |
